Rogers Arena - Vancouver, BC

Mixing: Zachary Semcken
Source: AKG C414 XLII (Hypercardioid) > MixPre 6 II (32 Bit Float @ 96)
Location: GA Floor, House Right Rear Rail, Aligned w/ House Right Stack, Approx. 45' from Stage, Mics PAS @ 13'
Editing: WAV > Reaper 6.69 (Gain, Mixing, Normalizing, Resample 32/48) > WAV (32 Bit Float @ 48) > Audacity 3.2.1 (Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)
